newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Cenbank supports Venezuela bolivar after rate fall.
newsitem.headline: Cenbank supports Venezuela bolivar after rate fall.

text.p: Central bank intervention shored up the Venezuelan bolivar, taking it to a narrowly lower close after the currency dipped to a 472 low to the dollar on a drop in interest rates at today's TEM bill auction, traders said.
The bolivar closed at 470.00/471.25 bolivars per dollar, slightly weaker than Tuesday's 469.50/470.50 finish.
Yields on benchmark six-month TEMs fell 256 basis points to 21.62 percent at today's 40 billion bolivar offering of Central Bank paper.
"Tomorrow should see a more stable market," said one trader.
